$comment: CockroachDB Cloud Managed MCP Server, scoped to the INTERLOCK cluster.
Anyone cloning this repo gets a read-only, audit-logged console over the
same memory the agents write to. Point your MCP client at this file and
you can ask questions like 'which intents were open when agent-3 committed'
without any risk of altering the incident you are investigating.
Auth: run `claude /mcp` and choose Authenticate for the OAuth flow, or set
CCLOUD_API_KEY for headless use (see agents/mcp.js, which does the latter).
The cluster id below is not a secret.
